Sarah Dean
Preserved Primary Document • dean-s1.htm
Sarah Dean was born in Kent Co., DE in
1847
according to the
1850
Kent County DE Census records. She was the daughter of  William Dean  and his wife,  (Mary) Ann Cork . Sometime betweem
1850
and
1860
the family moved to Romulus Twp., Wayne, MI. where they appear in the
1860
census records.
Sarah married Perry PERKINS, the son of Mitchel Perkins and Sarah Becketts, who was born in Delaware on September 15,
1840
. His occupation on the
1870
and
1880
Romulus Twp. census records is "farmer".
Chidren of Sarah and Perry Perkins were:
George W. Perkins    (b.
1868
in MI- d.
1943
in MI)
George married Mary Spaulding (
1874
-
1970
) . Both are buried
in Romulus Twp., Wayne, MI

Sarah Dean

Preserved Primary Document • dean-s1.htm

Sarah Dean was born in Kent Co., DE in 1847 according to the 1850 Kent County DE Census records. She was the daughter of William Dean and his wife, (Mary) Ann Cork . Sometime betweem 1850 and 1860 the family moved to Romulus Twp., Wayne, MI. where they appear in the 1860 census records. Sarah married Perry PERKINS, the son of Mitchel Perkins and Sarah Becketts, who was born in Delaware on September 15, 1840. His occupation on the 1870 and 1880 Romulus Twp. census records is "farmer". Chidren of Sarah and Perry Perkins were: George W. Perkins (b. 1868 in MI- d. 1943 in MI) George married Mary Spaulding (1874-1970) . Both are buried in Romulus Twp., Wayne, MI Sarah Ann Perkins (b.
